value.rationale: The exact variance measures a natural zero-hit statistic across every primitive orbit of a classical recurrence modulo every dyadic level. It isolates a genuine, nonconstant second-order property concealed by the level-independent mean and identifies the prime-adic lag strata responsible for it, beyond one-off computations.
